newsitem.title: USA: Meredith Q3 revs feel pinch of lower ads.
newsitem.headline: Meredith Q3 revs feel pinch of lower ads.

text.p: Meredith Corp said revenues for the March 31 third quarter, which increased two percent from a year ago, were held down by lower advertising revenues at Ladies' Home Journal magazine.

The company also cited fiscal 1996 actions that included closing Home Garden and Weekend Woodworking magazines, reducing the rate base at Ladies' Home Journal and changing the number of issues published by Country America to six from 10.
For the quarter, revenues rose to $233 million from $219.4 million. Excluding the effects of the changes, company revenues increased about five percent quarter-over-quarter.
Earnings for the quarter increased to $0.33 per share from $0.24 a year ago. Revenues were $223 million, up from $219.4 million.
